plugin.description: Find solutions to problems using current market options from Kado.
plugin.short_description: Find current solutions with the Kado CLI
plugin.long_description: Use Kado Search to describe a user's problem, outcome, context, and constraints, then find current market options across tools, agents, vendors, agencies, services, and architecture choices.
plugin.default_prompt: Use $kado-search to find current solutions for our slow onboarding and early user drop-off.

skill.description: Find current external solutions to a user's problem with Kado. Use for recommendations, comparisons, shortlists, vendor or agency discovery, build-vs-buy choices, architecture options, migrations, procurement, and implicit pain points that benefit from current market options. Do not use for a local code edit, a stable factual answer, or when the user says not to search.
skill.compatibility: Requires the installed kado CLI and network access to https://kado.so; install from https://kado.so/install.

claude.name: kado
claude.description: Kado plugins for finding solutions to problems using current market options.
